visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male baseball player wearing a blue and white jersey with the number 58 on his back stands in an indoor batting cage. He grips a green baseball bat firmly, assuming a ready stance with his knees slightly bent and his head turned toward the pitcher. The setting is a large sports facility with bright natural lighting filtering through the open sides of the structure. The ground is covered in green artificial turf, and heavy netting surrounds the practice area to contain the balls. (2) As a ball is delivered, the player executes a powerful swing, making sharp contact. His body rotates fully, with his eyes following the ball's trajectory. In the background, a second person, likely a coach or assistant, stands near a pitching machine and a protective L-screen, observing the batter's form. The lighting is consistent and bright, highlighting the texture of the player's white baseball pants and the metallic structure of the facility's roof. (3) The player resets his position after each swing, tapping his bat on the ground and adjusting his grip. This repetition occurs several times, demonstrating a training routine. On the final swing shown, he puts forth maximum effort, with his facial expression showing intense concentration. The background remains constant, featuring brick buildings and green trees visible through the mesh netting under a clear blue sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with the ambient room tone of a spacious indoor sports hall. A sudden, sharp transient crack signifies the baseball bat hitting the ball, characterized by a high-frequency peak and a short duration. No background music is present, allowing the raw acoustic sounds of the practice to dominate. The noise floor includes a faint mechanical hum, possibly from equipment in the facility. (2) A second batting event occurs, followed by a brief, low-volume vocalization from a male in the background with a neutral, professional tone. The impact sounds are crisp and clear, indicating a high-quality field recording. The acoustic environment has a slight reverb, suggesting a large, semi-enclosed space. The lack of music emphasizes the rhythmic nature of the batting practice. (3) After several repeated batting impacts, the main speaker's vocalizations become more prominent. Following a forceful swing, he lets out a loud, high-arousal shout that peaks in intensity, indicating physical strain and satisfaction. His voice has a sharp, bright quality with significant pitch variability during the shout. The sequence ends with the low-frequency thuds of footsteps on the artificial turf.
